approach: Fix it where the reader's inputs are built. `referenced_jobs` in crates/athena-core/src/reading/topics.rs resolves only ids written in the request text, so ids cited by the retried job's introspection (`RetryCause.earlier_cases[].job` and job ids in the cause, prevention, proposed request and case texts) never reach the reader with their recorded shape. Change it to take the retried `Option<&EarlierAttempt>`. Carry request-named jobs first, under the existing `MAX_REFERENCED_JOBS`. Then carry introspection-cited jobs under a second cap, `MAX_CITED_JOBS`, deduped against the jobs actually carried (round-1 finding 5). Everything goes through the existing `carry()`, so it is redacted and bounded and has deliverables, criteria and changed files. The reader brief's "Referenced jobs" section prints each job's recorded criteria and deliverables and tells the reader to take fixtures, sizes and thresholds from them. The "Previous result and change scope" intro gains one sentence: only the retried job and followed-up jobs must be accounted for. `continued_jobs`, `check_prior_result_and_scope` and `refusing_check` are untouched, so nothing new is refused (0% of past accepted readings newly refused). The through-the-real-path proof is a new cli test in retry.rs that drives read_once → referenced_jobs → carry → reader_brief for a retry whose only link to an earlier job is the introspection (round-1 finding 1). Limit, stated in the CHANGELOG: ids the reader invents inside its own reading are not resolved by this change (round-1 finding 4).

decisions.choice: Extend `referenced_jobs` to take `attempt: Option<&EarlierAttempt>` (replacing `skip: Option<&str>`) and read the cited ids from `attempt.introspection` through a new pure helper `introspection_cited_ids(&RetryCause) -> Vec<RecordId>`.
decisions.reason: The ids are lost exactly there. `RetryCause.earlier_cases[].job` already holds them (reader.rs:108-113 prints them as text only) and `read_once` already has `attempt` (reading.rs:579, call at 603-608). One resolver and one `carry()` path (redaction, bounds) are reused and nothing new is stored.

decisions.choice: Request-named jobs keep `MAX_REFERENCED_JOBS` (3) and come first. Introspection-cited jobs follow under `MAX_CITED_JOBS = 4`. The cited ids are deduped against the jobs actually carried, not against every id considered.
decisions.reason: A real retry cites 1 job in the request and 3 earlier cases in the introspection. Separate caps mean cited jobs never displace a request-named job (criterion 3). Deduping against carried jobs means a request-named id that the request cap dropped is still carried when the introspection cites it (finding 5).

rejected.option: One shared cap of 3 with introspection ids last
rejected.why: Drops cited jobs in the common case of 1 request id plus 3 earlier cases.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in crates/athena-core/src/reading/topics.rs `mod tests`, names starting `referenced_jobs_`. Records hold job A (id not in the request, deliverables `modify crates/x/a.rs` and `create crates/x/b.rs`) and the retried job B. The attempt is `EarlierAttempt{job: B, introspection: Some(RetryCause{earlier_cases:[EarlierCase{job: Some(A),..}],..}), ..}`. Variants: (a) A only in `earlier_cases[].job`; (b) A only in `RetryCause.cause` text, `earlier_cases` empty; (c) A only in `prevention` text; (d) B is never returned, an id in no record is ignored, and `attempt: None` gives request-named jobs only. Each calls `referenced_jobs(&records, request, Some(&attempt), &redactor)` and asserts A comes back with `reading_deliverables == ["modify crates/x/a.rs", "create crates/x/b.rs"]`.

demonstrations.seam: `referenced_jobs` and `reader_brief`, called directly with the same fixtures as criteria 1 and 2 (exist or added by steps 1 and 2); the signature change and `MAX_CITED_JOBS` are added by step 2.

demonstrations.method: topics.rs test `referenced_jobs_doc_and_changelog_name_the_cause`. It finds the marker with `concat!("pub fn ", "referenced_jobs(")` in `include_str!("topics.rs")`, walks back over the contiguous `///` lines above it, and asserts that block contains the phrases `concat!("never ", "resolved")` and `concat!("in", "vented")`. It then slices `include_str!("../../../../CHANGELOG.md")` from `## [Unreleased]` (CHANGELOG.md:8) to the next `## [` heading and asserts the slice names 20261109-075120-7zqw, 20261029-111121-fzx0 and 20261110-124307-bn3c and the same two phrases. The verifier also runs Grep on the CHANGELOG ids and on the `///` block above `pub fn referenced_jobs(` only.
demonstrations.observes: The doc block and the Unreleased entry name the cause and the three instances. The test's own literals are split, so they cannot satisfy the search.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the doc comment or the CHANGELOG entry the extracted block or slice lacks the phrases and ids, and the test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Plain `include_str!` of two repository files; no double. The text is written by steps 2 and 8.

demonstrations.method: `git diff --stat` must not list crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs, so there is no new `step!`/`check_` function. The existing prior-result tests stay green (reading.rs 3764-3837 and 4288-4387, which pass cited-only `referenced` jobs and expect them not accounted for). refusal_corpus.rs gets one case, `introspection-cited-job-carried-but-not-relied-on` (Expected::Accept): the retried job has an introspection citing OTHER_JOB, `referenced` holds OTHER_JOB, and the reading names only the retried job. Existing cases I read there: root-cause-cites-two-jobs-without-relying (Accept), follow-up-on-a-job-the-reading-ignores (Refuse check_prior_result_and_scope), retry-complaint-reading-names-the-job (Accept), retry-complaint-reading-omits-the-job (Refuse check_prior_result_and_scope). Together they show cited jobs are not accounted for and followed-up jobs still are. Refused share: 0% of past accepted readings, because no rule is added. I could not run the corpus test and cite only case ids I read.
demonstrations.observes: All corpus cases keep their outcomes and the new case is accepted; `git diff --stat` shows no checks.rs.
demonstrations.fails_without: A change that turned carried `referenced` jobs into jobs to account for would make the new case refuse and fail. A new `step!` would make `every_acceptance_check_has_a_refusing_corpus_case` demand a refusing case.
demonstrations.seam: `refusing_check` driven by the corpus `Case` and `run` (exist, refusal_corpus.rs:72, 2595). Step 7 adds the case; `RetryCause` and `EarlierCase` are already exported from `athena_context::briefs`.

demonstrations.method: A briefs.rs test with a cited-only job whose `reading_deliverables` is set. It asserts the deliverables are quoted under both `# Referenced jobs` and the `PRIOR_RESULT_HEADING` entry. It asserts the `PRIOR_RESULT_HEADING` section has exactly one line starting `Job ` per job (as at briefs.rs:3969-3970), and that the new intro sentence is present. `git diff --stat` must list no file under crates/athena-context/prompts.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-context brief && cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets
demonstrations.observes: The brief tests pass with one `Job ` line per job in the prior-result section. The budgets test passes with reader 1998 of 2000 unchanged, because no prompt file changes.
demonstrations.fails_without: A `Job ` line added inside `carried_work` fails the job-line count. A prompt edit changes the computed budget and fails `system_facts_budgets_match_computed`.
demonstrations.seam: `reader_brief` and `carried_work` (exist, reader.rs:199, 318) and the budgets test (exists, crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs). No new seam.

demonstrations.method: Run the three whole-workspace checks, which include the cli tests that drive the real brief (retry.rs, lifecycle.rs:766-786).

demonstrations.seam: The checks Athena runs on the result; no double.
